body:
I’m fighting for everyone in PA who’s gotten knocked down and had to get back up.
#
Hi Derek, it’s John Fetterman.
I *just* finished a day full of rallies with President Obama + President Biden and I wanted to reach out one last time before the night is over.
**Days like today remind me exactly why I’m fighting so hard to win this Senate seat.** Losing this race to Dr. Oz will have very real repercussions for working people in Pennsylvania + across the country — and we can’t afford to slow our roll over these next three days.
After suffering a stroke earlier this year, I was reminded of the sheer number of folks who’ve supported me through this race + want to change the status quo.
**That stroke knocked me down, but I got back up.** And now, I’m fighting for everyone in PA who’s gotten knocked down and had to get back up.
**[If you have my back, can you chip in any amount to my campaign right now? Your support will carry me through Election Day, and I’m just so deeply grateful.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221105-4?refcode=em20221105-8079&refcode2=8079_434096_ZqqpLt&akid=8079%2E434096%2EZqqpLt)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221105-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221105-8079&refcode2=8079_434096_ZqqpLt&akid=8079%2E434096%2EZqqpLt)**
I’m fighting for real people all across PA + all across the country — from protecting women’s reproductive freedom, to raising the minimum wage, to protecting Social Security to fighting to make sure everyone can access the health care coverage they need.
Meanwhile, Dr. Oz continues his old trend: Lying on TV + taking advantage of everyday people for his own personal profit. He’s so out-of-touch, he wouldn’t even know where to begin representing someone from PA.
**[If we’re going to defeat Dr. Oz + flip PA blue on November 8, I need you in my corner over these next 3 days. Will you rush a donation of any amount to my campaign right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221105-4?refcode=em20221105-8079&refcode2=8079_434096_ZqqpLt&akid=8079%2E434096%2EZqqpLt)**
**[Contribute Now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221105-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221105-8079&refcode2=8079_434096_ZqqpLt&akid=8079%2E434096%2EZqqpLt)**
Thank you so much for all your support.
I couldn’t do this without you.
❤️ John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

| | GWINN, Mich. — This year, growing support for Dr. Bob Lorinser's Congressional bid appears to have the embattled incumbent, Rep. Jack Bergman, nervous. Constituents of all political backgrounds — Democrats, Republicans, Independents, and voters without party affiliation — are gravitating to Dr. Bob's habitual honesty and his 'no B.S.' approach to policy.
"It's been difficult for my opponent to define me," concedes Lorinser. "I understand. Our political system is so divided that there's a tendency to categorize candidates as 'one of us' or 'one of them,' with no in-between. Too many Washington politicians are aligning with the fringes of their parties. The consequence is; Nothing meaningful gets done.
"Where has statesmanship gone? I'm running on a platform to help bring cooperation, compromise, and collaboration back to Michigan's 1st District. Refusing to compromise is not strength, and it's not representational. A leader never ignores constituents even when they disagree because when a Congressman goes at it alone, they might as well be lost."
Lorinser's positions are a refreshing smorgasbord of solutions. Dr. Bob rejects labels entirely and scoffs when asked if he considers himself a progressive, a moderate, or a conservative.
"I'm not interested in those labels," he says. "I completely reject them. Completely. We need less focus on how we define a politician and more focus on how we define problems and solutions. My allegiance belongs to the hardworking people of this district before partisan ideology. Period."

#
Team, we're sorry to be so direct, but Mandela Barnes really needs you to chip in today.
This Wisconsin Senate race is one of the most important races in the country, but we're currently projected to come up short of our fundraising goals. Missing our goals this close to Election Day could mean trouble for our campaign.
That's why we're asking you directly:
[**Please rush a donation of $3 – or whatever you can afford – to Mandela Barnes’ campaign for Senate before it's too late.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221105-5-tt&t=1&akid=3997%2E196590%2EXO7eMx)

**Here's how it all breaks down:**
* Last week, the GOP and Ron Johnson’s super PACs dropped an additional **_$5.7 million on attack ads aimed at Mandela_** spreading deceptive smears in the final days of this campaign.

* Mandela rejects corporate PAC money, which means **_we need a LOT of donations in order to fund our GOTV efforts._**

* This election will decide which party holds the Senate majority. And we cannot allow Mitch McConnell to be put back in power.

On Election Day we are facing an unprecedented opportunity to rebuild the middle class, codify Roe v. Wade into law, and make the progress that this country needs.
With everything at stake and **_literally 3 days**_ before it's all over, what do you say?
[**Can you please rush a $3 donation to elect Mandela Barnes, help our campaign get out the vote, and defend the Democratic Senate majority?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221105-5-tt&t=3&akid=3997%2E196590%2EXO7eMx)
Thank you in advance for your support today. Mandela really needs you with him if we're going to have any hope to flip this seat.
Team Mandela

clean_body: If we lose this election -- if we lose control of the House and Senate -- we have a different world. That’s not a world I want -- and I don’t think you do either. | | You’ve heard me say it before, Derek: We’re at an inflection point in American history. What happens in the next two to three years is going to determine what this country looks like 30 years from now. It’s not hyperbole. There’s so much at stake. Roe was settled for 50 years. But think about what’s happening. MAGA Republicans are banning abortion in the case of rape and incest in many states. Well, Derek, if we elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House, we could codify Roe. We could once again make Roe the law of the land. Election Day is Tuesday, and Kamala and I need to know you’re with us. Make a $7 donation to the DNC today to help elect more Democrats to the Senate, protect our House majority, and ensure Democrats nationwide have the resources to win. If we lose this election -- if we lose control of the House and Senate -- we have a different world. That’s not a world I want -- and Derek, I don’t think you do either. subject: URGENT: Only TWO DAYS Left To Stop Jim Jordan

body:
Hey team,
I was recently doing some decluttering around the house to help with election season stress, and I came across my son’s favorite book as a kid. It’s called, “if You Give a Mouse a Cookie,” by Laura Numeroff/Felicia Bond. For those of you who have never read it, it’s a wonderful, goofy book about a mouse asking for more and more stuff after the narrator gives him a cookie. I had a good laugh while reading it, but it made me wonder: what would happen if we gave Jim Jordan another victory, a cookie, this year? So I’ve decided to write my own spinoff here, called “If you give an extremist a win” by Tamie Wilson.
If you give an extremist a win, he’s going to take away your abortion rights.
When he’s finished, he’ll probably strip your right to birth control. After he takes that right, he’ll want to go after your right to vote. Once he takes your right to vote, he’ll take your right to free speech, since you already can’t exercise your right to get him out of office. If you give an extremist a win, he’ll keep asking for your rights, and by the time it’s too late, you won’t have to give him a win for him to do what he wants. The end.
We need to think about the long-term consequences of letting Jim Jordan get another term in Congress. He is partnering with right-wing RADICALS who have an EXTREMIST anti-freedom, anti-democracy agenda. He has NO plans to help his district this next term, he only wants to help Trump and the rest of his cronies in the GOP. They are going after our most fundamental rights as Americans. But, if you give a moderate a donation ($25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or even $2,900), she’ll GIVE back to you: reproductive freedom, workers’ rights, and sensible politics. Please chip in today and help save our country and our rights!
Thanks,
Tamie

name: Pro Life Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbamp4056dsc2hv0b1qe7unn7lv5c1ebto49a47o_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj64ob4c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn2gen1rph2ql11n3nab393h863qofcf95l95dr0_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj64ob4c5h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zssp6flh58ln1a3c2mqldlm3rcj9tno00s8u66fg_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj64ob4c5h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: a personal plea

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0iljcnrq8s5c93619igklvbihsl5bcsimjf5kag_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj6eo72cth2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Friend, I'm reaching out today to talk about what makes Florida so different. It comes down to one word: **_decency._**
Like you, I've been shocked and dismayed by how vulgar and mean-spirited our politics have become. When I look back on the last four years, I’m especially devastated by how DeSantis’s agenda has managed to send voting rights, women’s rights, LGBTQ rights back decades.
Leaders should work to unite us around policies that will help everyone, not divide and distract us. And I know from experience that it starts at the top.
Every day, I strive to live according to The Golden Rule: "_Do unto others as you would have them do unto you._ "
Our current Governor doesn’t seem to share those same values.
Floridians want leaders who lead with kindness, selflessness, and above all else: decency. **[_If you agree, I hope you'll chip in to put an end to Ron DeSantis’s hateful rhetoric and ideas._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54147410/377575455/563077528?amount=25&refcode=20221106_f_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWI4ZGNlZi1kMjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r1-QiP2lweZjkNQrFFUr0qTqAW2QDR-MGveLE-RlW40=)**

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z08u4gv9slr3sbl25nl5iqrl5b7ecpd21t1tn4v8_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj64ob6c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 9 Felonies for Exposing Planned Parenthood
body:
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot.
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4ughbmhos8phqp2rgbbbeo5k2cgp7499oeoujr8_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0q37dsavbnmd7rc7fecv160060q388u9fg7q17g_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbrhjch2o0m1jdsprdnsd7v96lopj042gppnfauo_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment – they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf18nurbtt1bembfmj8umhv4n1g4oil1fhvpk6mg_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrq9nsmh35or6jik3tq9cdn4303ncqpqtiil279g_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND of $35, $50, $100 or more to stop this attempt to crush him?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zl36qel8f00bgc6v484vi8vtdd2kaff2pqceobj0_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs)** [**DONATE**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zu0n907q4d03d5bua3llh67a1l916fbb147f9l5o_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs) [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhrv23j1lka9dgarmic58tafrhk3q0qpighee4do_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctgm8ob4c5h2bs) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. body:
Running to deliver the Black & Hispanic votes to the GOP [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c7551%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=0C1Tayfj5xUyv6eLmrZhgQ&sysid=1)

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77984%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bIIjyc4p3rSgDJFZqBNf0g&sysid=1)

Friend,

There’s just no time, so we’ll keep the introductions short. Our names are Jennifer-Ruth Green & Catalina Lauf.

_**SHORT TERM: we’re the two minority conservatives running to deliver the Black & Hispanic votes to the GOP for the first time in American History. **_

Long-term: we’re the two minority conservatives running to put an end to the Democratic party for good.

_**Well, now we are --Nancy Pelosi is spending millions to silence us. **_

She knows her party can’t suffer another humiliating defeat from the Black community or the Hispanic community. Her grip on power depends on it. Her entire party depends on it.

Winning the Black & Hispanic vote would be a decades-long setback for the Democrats. If we succeed, we would never lose an election to them again. But voters are already casting ballots, and the early vote is going to Democrats right now.
****

[**HELP US SECURE VICTORY**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77995%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=w9OMIzQbhIqTGFo6OvxBaQ&sysid=1)

This email is our last hope, and it all comes down to you.

[**We would be honored if you joined us today.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77996%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2WyIj%2fcN9tU032iX4%2fZZFQ&sysid=1)

Thank you,

Jennifer-Ruth & Catalina Lauf
GOP Candidates for U.S Congress

[********](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77997%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=plRk6Md17F%2btvTESKlrB1w&sysid=1)

## Get Your Money Out of U.S. Banks Immediately
* * *
A Wall Street legend has warned 8.4 million Americans to prepare immediately.
"[**A historic financial reset in 2023**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziij2vl78t1agsfbkhrrkcruclaq6m4si7l0ivi8_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj66o32cjh2bs) could cause _a run on the banks_ unlike anything we've seen in our country's history," he says.
Marc Chaikin has already appeared on 30 different TV networks to share his warning. Even CNBC's Jim Cramer has taken notice.
[**But few people realize this could actually happen on U.S. soil**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbvl7n4frjklkcj4ns3tt5df6ac2hv6aj8gfvpvg_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj66o32cjh2bs). Or what a sizable impact it could have on your wealth, especially if you have large amounts of cash in the bank right now.
Chaikin is best known for predicting the COVID-19 crash, the 2022 sell-off, and the overnight collapse of Priceline during a CNBC debate. In his 50-year Wall Street career, he worked with hedge funds run by billionaires Paul Tudor Jones and George Soros.
But today, he is now urging you to move your money out of cash and popular stocks and into [**a new vehicle 50 years in the making**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2krt639dq0cu1frbqgnd0c73ds2mcnhf0j2vmr0_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj66o32cjh2bs).
"This is by far the best way to protect and grow your money in what will surely be a very difficult transition for most people," Chaikin says.
[**Click here for the full story, and his free recommendation**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmep2adb2aqu94lljobc4rth6s7jiqdvjf48dql8_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctj66o32cjh2bs).
Good investing,
Marc Gerstein

Can you chip in just $5 before the day ends to help us reach as many voters as possible?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54148934/377581557/1188041192?refcode=em_fr_2022.11.06_b1_cd_all&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMWI3ODQ0ZS1kYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jrPco-aevUU99w1H50_0JL_Er2i0pdhxoUhXD42TwqI=)

**But we have something worth so much more: A strong grassroots team, grown right here in western PA.**

Our campaign resonates with western Pennsylvania families because we’re fighting for the things that matter most – **bringing our supply chains back home, stronger protection for workers and unions, taking on unchecked corporate power, making billionaires and big corporations pay their fair share, protecting our right to vote, ensuring that women and girls across the country have access to legal abortion, and so much more.**

**So here’s the plan, Derek: With only 2 days left, it’s all about our ground game.** It’s critical we connect with as many voters as possible, which means knocking on every single door we can in Beaver and Allegheny Counties and talking to folks about the issues that matter most.

[**But doing all of that is expensive, Derek, and unlike my opponent, I’m not backed by mega-rich corporate PACs. **Nate Silver's _FiveThirtyEight_ just dramatically increased my chances of LOSING Nevada's Senate seat. If that happens, Democrats will not hold the Senate majority.**
I have seen firsthand what the Senate is like with Mitch McConnell in charge: a graveyard of progress and a hall of obstruction. I do not want our race to be the reason McConnell and my Trump-endorsed opponent get their hands on Senate control.******So we are doing something we've never done before: trying to raise $750,000 by 11:59 P.M. tonight.**
This is the biggest grassroots fundraising goal I've ever set, and I need you to understand why: **Experts at _The New York Times_ , _CNN_ , _The Cook Political Report_ – the list goes on and on – have said I am the most vulnerable senator on the ballot, and polling shows me 1 point down to my opponent, Adam Laxalt (R).**
**Because of that, Mitch McConnell and his allies are spending more than $55 million to defeat me. **With Nevadans already casting ballots, _The Hill_ and _Yahoo News_ are reporting that OUR race could "doom" Democrats' hopes of holding the Senate.

**Back in 2016, Mitch McConnell and his allies spent tens of millions of dollars against me. The pundits thought I would lose. But I defied the odds, as well as all the right-wing money against me, to win by 2.4 points and become our nation's first Latina U.S. senator.**
So how did we pull it off? With people like you, friend. People like you donating $10, $20, $50 at a time by the thousands to counter McConnell's megadonor money. That's precisely what it will take to win this time, which is why we've set this ambitious goal to raise $750,000 by tonight's 11:59 p.m. deadline.

The stakes of this race are so high, Derek.
* In our post-_Roe_ world, reproductive rights will be determined on a state-by-state basis, meaning the next Governor will decide if abortion remains safe, legal, and accessible here in Pennsylvania. My opponent says his “#1 issue” is passing an abortion ban with absolutely no exceptions — a bill I wouldn’t hesitate to veto.

* The very foundations of our democracy are at stake because the next Governor will appoint the official who runs our elections — and will get to decide how we vote in future elections.

[**This critical Senate race could be over unless I hear from you and 15 more conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804355:6CWf_8G8N:m:1:3317145305:70FA5B1321F6165A686597CD0EB6321C:r)

Now is not the time to fall behind - **too much is at stake in this election for us to lose.** I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? **REACH OUT TO YOU, Peter.**

[**Please, answer my call today and rush in your support.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804355:6CWf_8G8N:m:1:3317145305:70FA5B1321F6165A686597CD0EB6321C:r) If I win - Republicans will win back the Senate majority. **If I lose** - well, you know. We can't let that happen.

The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority.

[**Please, Peter, I need to hear from you and 15 other conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes or this race could over.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804355:6CWf_8G8N:m:1:3317145305:70FA5B1321F6165A686597CD0EB6321C:r)

Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. **I 'm counting on hearing from you.**

For America,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804356:6CWf_8G8N:m:1:3317145305:70FA5B1321F6165A686597CD0EB6321C:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Friends and Supporters,
We are in the final stretch. We have the opportunity to finally flip a seat that has been a Democrat stronghold for decades. We cannot quit, we must stand strong in the face of adversity.
My opponent Katherine Clark and Joe Biden are ruining our country rapidly. Our economy, our energy independence, our education system, our border, and crime in our communities, all trending in the wrong direction.
I am asking for your help in any way you can. If you cannot help you can always donate. We must have a strong "GET OUT THE VOTE EFFORT" on TUESDAY!

Go out to a Supermarket in the District this weekend and hand out Caroline's literature.
Hold a sign on election day at the polls.
Make phone calls? Can you text voters.
Click on any task displayed in the above boxes and let us know you can help. Someone from our campaign will be in touch with you with instructions and lists.
Weather is supposed to be good on Tuesday and all indications are that many will be voting in person on election day. It is important we have a presence at every location. Massachusetts must see a RED WAVE ON TUESDAY.
Here is a list of cities and towns in the district:
Arlington - Bedford - Belmont - Cambridge - Framingham - Lexington - Lincoln - Malden - Maynard - Medford - Melrose - Natick - Revere - Stoneham - Sudbury - Waltham - Watertown - Wayland - Wellesley - Weston - Winchester - Woburn - and Winthrop
Signs and literature are both available at 4 Patrick Circle in Stoneham in the driveway. You can take what you need.
Too much is at stake in this election. Massachusetts must ride the red wave. Your help is greatly appreciated. Thank you.
To Victory, Team Caroline

name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 9 Felonies for Exposing Planned Parenthood
body:
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0063%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=VupWfQaRT8a3TMiVnTMxMQ&sysid=1)
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49608%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DSg6NQ0JUU74hLiF5JkY%2bg&sysid=1)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49609%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jDmhDwpq9dBVD8xgTqw8bA&sysid=1)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49600%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=L%2fKnbqdx1IW2eDIixOQwcA&sysid=1)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49601%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Yurjp2d8rz%2b4h1fQTLAFgQ&sysid=1)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49602%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yo%2bO2ZKiAYhzAlD%2fzlCLPg&sysid=1)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND of $35, $50, $100 or more to stop this attempt to crush him?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49603%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nK5WGDSQSlM2NVv%2fryGdXg&sysid=1)** [**DONATE**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49604%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lvDEh2UrPUCjRTYT2GBW%2bA&sysid=1) [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49615%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=W5lsJA8fWQDRxlZQOuCtHg&sysid=1) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. [Please consider supporting our efforts with a generous, tax-deductible donation.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49616%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3J2lUfEpOLcRmmgOBlYesg&sysid=1) (C) Thomas More Society | [www.thomasmoresociety.org](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c49617%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8LxFYUcT738wCBchiIA3XQ&sysid=1)

name: Richard Walker
subject: Doctor indoctrination

Peter,

For hundreds of years, doctors have vowed to _" fulfill, to the best of my ability and judgment, this covenant: I will respect the hard-won scientific gains . . . and gladly share such knowledge as is mine with those who are to follow."_

The Hippocratic oath has stood as a guideline for physicians caring for their patients.

_**But now it 's being replaced. . . **_

The medical establishment is losing trust because they've abandoned the principles of the doctor-patient relationship.

Let me introduce myself. I am Richard Walker, Executive Director at the Benjamin Rush Institute (BRI). I've set a goal to raise $50,000 before the end of November to help medical students resist wokeness in medical schools.

[_**This is your chance to reverse the decay of the doctor-patient relationship. Can I count on you to donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount today? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61805431:J50Ne8G4N:m:1:3331703221:F20C7DBC936F58B572DD327D64B61814:r)

The University of Minnesota is now having its medical students swear an oath to:

_" Honor all Indigenous ways of healing that have been historically marginalized by Western medicine" and fight "white supremacy, colonialism, [and] the gender binary."_

**They are basically indoctrinating new doctors into the cult of Critical Race Theory (CRT).**

BRI is fighting to help medical students overcome the push toward socialized, CRT-focused healthcare.

[_**Your generous donation helps BRI chapters educate medical students, re-focus healthcare policy on inviolate doctor-patient autonomy, and create a lasting legacy of healthcare freedom and medical excellence. Click here to show your support >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61805431:J50Ne8G4N:m:1:3331703221:F20C7DBC936F58B572DD327D64B61814:r)

Most medical students today rarely receive instruction about healthcare policy. If they do, however, the focus overwhelmingly promotes a government-mandated, insurance company approach to healthcare. And the pressure from some of their peers can be even worse.

_They rarely -- if ever -- encounter a voice promoting free enterprise and the sanctity of the patient-doctor relationship._

**BRI fills the gap in schools where free enterprise healthcare policy discussions are under-represented or even entirely absent.**

BRI's Chapters give medical students a place to learn how a free enterprise healthcare policy can deliver affordable, quality medical care to their patients.

**We hold events every year and expose thousands of medical students to free-market healthcare policy solutions.**

Your support helps us show the next generation of medical students how they can protect the doctor-patient relationship as the primary means of delivering quality medical care. Donate by clicking any amount below.

Dear Friends,
Today is the LAST DAY of in-person early voting — so if you haven’t voted yet, click below to find an early voting location near you!
Vote Early Broward [https://www.browardvotes.gov/Voting-Methods/Early-Voting-Dates-Hours-and-Sites]
Vote Early Palm Beach [https://www.pbcelections.org/Voters/Early-Voting]
If we want to send a leader like Jared Moskowitz to Congress to defend our democracy, lower costs, prevent gun violence, and protect abortion rights, we need to show up and VOTE!
In-person early voting sites are open through 7pm across our community. And if you received a vote-by-mail ballot but have not yet returned it, the best way to make sure it’s received on time is to drop it off at an early voting location or at the Supervisor of Elections’ office.
Thanks,
Team Jared
PS: If you’ve already voted, forward this email to your friends and family to make sure they have a plan to vote!

| With Early Voting wrapping up, it’s time to turn our focus to the next critical stage of our mission to take back the House...

A mainstream media so bereft of substance it fails in every facet the Constitution envisioned for it, especially informing the voting populace of the truth without fear or favor. __** **__[That is why I made this video I consider to be the most important of my life. 3 minutes of SHARING FACTS ON WHAT JOE BIDEN AND DEMOCRATCS HAVE ACCOMPLISHED, SO WE REMIND EVERYONE HOW WE MUST VOTE, AND VOTE FOR DEMOCRATS! * **_PRESIDENT BIDEN CREATED SIX MILLION JOBS IN 2021, AN ALL-TIME RECORD!? _**
* **_JOE BIDEN & DEMOCRATS HAVE CREATED THE MOST MANUFACTURING JOBS IN 30 YEARS!? _**
* **_WITH THE CHILD TAX CREDIT--WHICH EVERY REPUBLICAN OPPOSED--THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION & DEMOCRATS IN CONGRESS LOWERED CHILDHOOD POVERTY BY THE GREATEST PERCENTAGE EVER!? _**
* **_AFTER A GENERATION OF OTHERS TRYING, JOE BIDEN & DEMOCRATS--AGAIN, WITHOUT A REPUBLICAN VOTE!!--GAVE MEDICARE THE RIGHT TO BULK NEGOTIATE PRESCRIPTION DRUG PRICES _****_AS PART OF THE INFLATION REDUCTION ACT _****_, WHICH WILL LOWER THE PRICE BY AN ESTIMATED 40-50%!?_**

**_[MOST AMERICANS DON'T KNOW THESE FACTS, YOU MAY NOT EVEN KNOW SOME OF THEM. SO I INCLUDED THEM AND MUCH MORE IN THIS VIDEO](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf6513dd6-72d4-45c9-8c09-ba1466ddcec1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[ AND ASK YOU TO PLEASE WATCH IT](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3bf04f8a-9dee-4858-a382-bcc7e53f46cf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) AND LET EVERYONE KNOW THEY MUST VOTE DEMOCRATIC. _** Please share it with everyone you know, those who need to turn out, need to be persuaded, or just are scared about what may happen on Tuesday & need a pick-me-up. **_[GET THIS IN FRONT OF REPUBLICANS, BECAUSE THEY SIMPLY CAN'T DENY ANY OF IT--OH THEY'LL TRY--BUT IT IS, AS THE FAMOUS LINE GOES,"JUST THE FACTS, MA'AM."](https://default.salsalabs.org/T61951288-8cae-41ef-a585-ba485bb60697/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **_So, no candidate messages here. But no matter what happens Tuesday, this community will remain & grow. And we'll continue to fight.** **_[PLEASE WATCH THE VIDEO](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4899cd78-4405-4bb5-9957-ea1b16a90b56/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) AND [SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8b23e90f-28cb-4002-acfa-2236871b847b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_**** ** **Thank you so much for being here and all you have done to fight for our democracy this past year. Over the course of the campaign, I’ve met with folks all over the state. Peter, too many people have to worry about their lack of wifi access, about their kids' classes being overcrowded because there’s not enough teachers, about crime, and about the fact that they can’t afford basic health care because McMaster refuses to expand Medicaid.

**What it boils down to is that McMaster has made life harder for a lot of South Carolinians.**

And that would be enough to warrant getting rid of his failed “leadership”, but there’s even more where that came from...

During our debate, he shared what he really thinks about our freedoms in South Carolina.

Not only is he still trying to completely outlaw abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest, but he also wants to ban same-sex marriage, and he doesn’t think climate change is real, even as floods make life here harder for so many folks.

That’s why I ran in the first place. I want to make life easier, not harder for South Carolinians — leveling the playing field and helping everyone prosper.

We have only 48 hours to do it, so let’s roll up our sleeves and finish the job.

subject: Just your endorsement

body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Peter, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

body:
Well, we officially blew the engine in my car. (No, seriously!)

After nearly a year of campaigning across TX-23, the engine in my car FINALLY burned out.

You don’t have to live in TX-23 to appreciate just how big this district really is.

Can you rush a contribution right now so we can ensure our volunteers have the resources they need as they travel across the district to help us unseat Tony Gonzales? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221101Engine_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=5]

For the last leg of my campaign, I put 23,000 miles on my mother’s car after mine finally bit the dust and I borrowed hers.

But one thing I learned while I was in the Marines — sometimes you just have to improvise.

And please keep in mind that when you’re driving across TX-23, sometimes it can feel like you’re driving on a treadmill! But I’ve really enjoyed seeing the beauty that this district has to offer.

The #1 thing you need to know is this: Our volunteers are out driving across the district nearly every day, which is why your support helps us keep them going with gas cards, snacks, bottles of water and more.

So today, I’m humbly asking:

Will you please make a $5 donation or more toward our people-powered movement? This is our chance to flip this seat blue and get right-wing extremist Tony Gonzales out of Washington. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221101Engine_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=5]

Thanks for all you do.

John

name: Andy Kim
subject: With the election upon us, a long email about democracy:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
It's the last weekend before Election Day; our team is working overtime to get out the vote, talk to voters, and get our message out to every corner of the district. That's an exciting project, as well as a big one, and we're counting on grassroots supporters like you to power us across the line. According to convention, that means I should ask you to chip in right here, at the top of the email.

Instead, I'd like to save the fundraising ask for the end of this note. First, I want to talk a little about our campaign's values, and the way that thousands of people's voices could be drowned out by one wealthy family.

Big money in politics isn't a new problem – our movement has been talking about the dangers since way before this election. Still, it's worth noting that our race this year offers a case study in how unrestricted spending threatens our democracy.

I've always looked at elections not as a chance to take power or to win at all costs, but as a chance to serve . That's why I've always built campaigns around listening, asking questions, responding to needs, and looking for ways to make life better for people in New Jersey. And by focusing on people, we have created an amazing movement made up of thousands (including you) who believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people.

My opponent, Bob Healey, has barely made an effort to connect with folks in our district. And because he has no experience in public service or in the workforce, he doesn't have any accomplishments to talk about.

But what he does have is money – lots of it – that he inherited from his family's business selling luxury yachts to the super-wealthy.

In addition to the $2 million his mom has dumped into a super PAC to attack me, Healey is giving his own campaign millions more. So far, he's spent $2.7 million of that inheritance to buy himself time on television to distort my record and lie about the work I've done to keep people safe, lower costs, and support our veterans. He gave himself $1.5 million of that money in just the last three weeks of October.

Some perspective: in those same three weeks, our campaign raised about a quarter of that, but from hundreds of people.

And there's the problem: one wealthy heir's whim can overpower the voices of hundreds of working families in our movement.

The only movement Bob Healey has created is the movement of his pen across his checkbook – but that's been enough to buy publicity and airtime. He's spent most of that time distorting my Congressional record and parroting dangerous right-wing talking points. And while he amplifies that dishonest nonsense, he also conveniently leaves out that his values are way out of line with our district:

*
He
wants
to
cut
taxes
on
ultra-luxury
purchases
(for
example,
the
yachts
that
he
profits
from);

*
He
sneers
at
tax
cuts
and
cost
savings
for
working
people;

*
He
wants
to
take
away
New
Jersey
women's
right
to
reproductive
health
care,
which
he
frames
as
a
"compromise."

These are extreme, and extremely dangerous positions, which is why most people in our district don't support them or him. Bob Healey is spending millions to try to shift the conversation, and unfortunately, it could work. This race is coming down to the wire.

We've pinched our pennies, we've done our homework, and we have a plan that can win. Together, we can counter his massive spending with grassroots support, and make sure the truth wins on Tuesday. Friend,
We’ll keep this short — Election Day is in less than 48 hours. If you plan on heading to the polls.
If you’ve voted in an election in PA before, **you do not need to show a photo ID to vote.**
Here’s **what you will need to bring if it’s your first time voting** in Pennsylvania:
**A valid photo ID** , such as a:
* Pennsylvania driver’s license or PennDOT ID card
* ID issued by any Commonwealth agency
* ID issued by the U.S. Government
* U.S. passport
* U.S. Armed Forces ID
* Student ID
* Employee ID

**If you don’t have a valid photo ID, that’s okay!**
**You can still vote** with a non-photo identification that includes your name and address such as a:
* Confirmation issued by the County Voter Registration Office
* Non-photo ID issued by the Commonwealth
* Non-photo ID issued by the U.S. Government
* Firearm permit
* Current utility bill
* Current bank statement
* Current paycheck
* Government check

| Hi ,
I know that you or someone you know needs to see this. ([Forward by clicking here](https://us14.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=d3494bf8d8&e=f9133ea432))

It’s not always clear where to vote for elections, so I want to make it easy for you.

Simply go here, and type in your address: [Voting Stations](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=90e04ed1e0&e=f9133ea432)

We are encouraging everyone we can to vote as soon as possible because this is a crucial moment in California’s history.

If you’re tired of paying the highest prices in the nation for gas, food, electricity, and the overall cost of living...

If you’re tired of seeing California have the highest poverty rate in the nation, while we have one of the world’s biggest economies and billions of dollars in a surplus budget...

If you’re tired of your children not being safe due to the high crime rates...

Then get to a voting station and vote for Brian Dahle!

Again - simply go here, and type in your address: [Voting Stations](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=93f1dda3d0&e=f9133ea432)

A vote for ‘Brian Dahle’ is a vote for change.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

body:
In order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.
#
Right now, we’re building one of the biggest organizing programs Texas has ever seen so we can make history and elect Beto as our next Governor.

Team Beto volunteers have already accomplished some amazing things. **But in order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.**

We’re reaching out to you because our campaign needs your help to make direct, personal contact with as many Texans as we can.
[**Will you sign up today for a virtual webinar for out-of-state Team Beto volunteers?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57318?t=1&akid=215840%2E444211%2EF_BpPo) We'll talk about how you can make the biggest impact, and you’ll have the chance to connect with fellow supporters.
**[Sign Up »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57318?t=2&akid=215840%2E444211%2EF_BpPo)**
Winning in Texas won't be easy, especially with the extreme voter suppression happening right in front of our eyes. But we know that we're capable of generating historic voter turnout and electing Beto, if we put in the work right now.
Thank you for being part of this,
Katherine Fischer

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9b9v4q2s48n8uvq6vemc4dbg57m5qm5rps3k4m8_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctim2o34cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z59pvrg4j5sgevqs54qtd7biobgmhh94389tnkm0_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctim2o34cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl9402aahilk3rjd28mf1ttrj2gaui9t0h3e1jt0_rp22sh2s8i66or7ctim2o34cdh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. **First, decide how you will vote:**

* If you're voting in-person, now is the time to decide:

**I left the Democratic Party because they 've become obsessed with pushing a woke agenda**.

Now, I'm doing all that I can to help Republican Senator Mike Lee win in November so he can return to Washington and defend our freedom.

I know Mike, and I worked with him when I was in Congress. I know him to be a man of principle, faith, and patriotism. | | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win on Tuesday.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td3f6d1fe-f136-4240-b1be-4c936d06b45c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

Peter,

I wouldn't be reaching out to you so **frantically** _if this wasn 't a dire situation..._ but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is **outraising my campaign** and we're less than two days away from Election Day.

[**This critical Senate race could be over unless I hear from you and 15 more conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804350:J0EFU8GN3:m:1:3331421248:4BA781AE7FE41FC1D3D4B8ACC5D1EE7D:r)

Now is not the time to fall behind - **too much is at stake in this election for us to lose.** I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? **REACH OUT TO YOU, Peter.**

[**Please, answer my call today and rush in your support.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804350:J0EFU8GN3:m:1:3331421248:4BA781AE7FE41FC1D3D4B8ACC5D1EE7D:r) If I win - Republicans will win back the Senate majority. **If I lose** - well, you know. We can't let that happen.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804350:J0EFU8GN3:m:1:3331421248:4BA781AE7FE41FC1D3D4B8ACC5D1EE7D:r)
