The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority.

**My campaign is being outraised** and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race.

[**Please, Peter, I need to hear from you and 15 other conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes or this race could over.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804350:J0EFU8GN3:m:1:3331421248:4BA781AE7FE41FC1D3D4B8ACC5D1EE7D:r)

Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. **I 'm counting on hearing from you.**

For America,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804351:J0EFU8GN3:m:1:3331421248:4BA781AE7FE41FC1D3D4B8ACC5D1EE7D:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty-like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author-C.S. Lewis.In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That's why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)," **we've received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis' writings.[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)We've also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won't last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last:[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-oSXIM-y2fDTw) Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01Vice PresidentNational Donor OutreachHillsdale College

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6240%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=TG4sxVEqMqfTXEctThiEHw&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80417%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=prxQM7guGOybO3ARtBlFEw&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80418%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EmwKmwMTQXq3A6K%2bzrtohg&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80419%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9EX4cYfKUgu0MqMZuJ9HeA&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80410%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oJ%2b%2b9wGMHCw8WejxiLOPIg&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80411%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=C44rKYWxgZxVBpFaxfklmA&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80412%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kqkO4sJTKZOZn0HMdQH37Q&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80413%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2e8wBvlMh%2bJeR8S%2f8CuPhA&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80414%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=L54ZWZR0ZGKPUOo%2bETsUsA&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80425%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QFG2ksORwwTXzQKpmv4qMg&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80426%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dOH3qH00HrcnfOM9mBAaGQ&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80427%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Mws6CY9zkjYGVJKYMThiug&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80428%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=L0qbOQllNNA1L4GEWjJrbQ&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Peter,

I know times are tough out there for everyone. We’re really feeling the effects of the Democrats’ America LAST policies here in West Michigan.
They’ve absolutely crushed our economy and life is harder under Biden than it was during President Trump and our shared agenda.

name: Charlie Crist
subject: Folks, he'll bully anyone who gets in his way
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Charlie Crist
body:
We all know that Ron DeSantis has his eye on the White House — and he’ll bully anyone who gets in his way.

Folks, I don’t back down from bullies. If you’re with me, I hope you’ll pitch in to support my fight.

>> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/focc-em-nov2022?refcode=20221106_f_5

Sometimes, it’s hard to believe just how low Ron DeSantis is willing to stoop.

He targeted LGBTQ+ kids and teachers in classrooms.

He attacked the Special Olympics.

He suspended a democratically elected state attorney because the attorney dared to stand up to Ron’s unconstitutional abortion ban.

And he’s even created his own personal “elections police” force to intimidate voters.

But here’s the good news: We have the opportunity to end this reign of extremism — if we work together and build the largest grassroots movement Florida’s ever seen.

That’s why I’m asking: Will you donate now to help me stand up to these bullying tactics and restore decency to our system of government?

>> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/focc-em-nov2022?refcode=20221106_f_5

I’m counting on you, folks.

— Charlie

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures🖼️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61804804:6UND08GvN:m:1:3368395361:471C1EC7F4E0AEA5CEA1D055EABE9510:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---

Protect Our Children and Support Families
---
---
As a mother, I am deeply concerned with the impact of pandemic-related policies on our youth. Despite being the least susceptible to serious illness, children faced the greatest disruptions - being kept out of school, forced into remote learning and isolated from friends and activities. The impacts have been most profound on the lower and middle class families who did not have access to technology nor the ability for parents to work remotely. We are now seeing the consequences of those tragic and heavy handed government policies:

* A growing youth mental health crisis.
* Declining academic scores in all districts.
* Language and speech deficits among our youngest learners and students where English is their second language.
* The spectrum of mandated COVID vaccines to attend school with no allowance for religious exemptions.
* Biased hiring practices in our school districts.
* Not enough support in the classrooms with mental, social and behavioral health.

**It’s time for CHANGE and a leader that champions children, parents and families! Parents deserve choices in where their children will learn best.**
**My opponent is no friend to schools, students and parents!**

* Himes has ignored the pleas from parents, teachers, and superintendents by voting**against "Protecting Our Children" Act that would have provided SROs. **
* Himes voted against mental health counselors funded by remaining COVID dollars.
* Himes has been silent as federal officials dictate harmful social doctrine in the classroom.
* Himes voted against an amendment to inform parents when their children receive mental health, crisis or other wellness services in school.

**Every student deserves access to quality education in a safe, unbiased learning environment.**
**IT'S TIME! Vote for Jayme Stevenson for Congress on Tuesday to protect parent’s rights to know when their children are in distress. Bring positive change to CT, vote Jayme to put the people of our congressional district FIRST! **
Thank you for your support,

Friend,

As we approach the finish line of this campaign, I want to tell y'all about the first thing that spurred me to seriously consider a run for Attorney General.

In 2019, I learned that a Sterigenics plant in my State Senate district was emitting a cancer-causing chemical called ethylene oxide. I believed that the Georgia Environmental Protection Division (EPD) had failed to do its job by allowing this plant to operate – they knew that the levels of ethylene oxide being released were causing harm to our local communities.

body:
It was your support that got us this far, and it’s your support that will get us across the finish line.
#
Derek, we’re officially in the final stretch of this campaign. But with how much is at stake this year, we still need all hands on deck.
That’s why we’re launching our **48 Hour GOTV Fund to raise $1 million before Election Day** — and we need your help to reach this final benchmark of the 2022 election.
We have to do everything in our power to support our GOTV efforts and ensure our on-the-ground volunteers have the resources to reach and turn out as many voters as possible before November 8.
**[Derek, can we count on your support today to help us meet our 48 Hour GOTV goal and boost our voter outreach efforts? Please consider donating $5 or more to help us reach our $1 million fundraising goal so we can turn out voters in all 67 counties.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-1?refcode=em20221106-8084&refcode2=8084_434096_Dmh3Fa&akid=8084%2E434096%2EDmh3Fa)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221106-8084&refcode2=8084_434096_Dmh3Fa&akid=8084%2E434096%2EDmh3Fa)**
From now until polls close, our campaign will be running at full speed to ensure that each and every voter in Pennsylvania is able to make it to the polls. Reaching our goal will allow us to stock up on everything we need to accomplish this — from clipboards and yard signs to posters and pens so our canvassers can confidently contact voters.
With so much left to do before November 8, it’s absolutely crucial that we keep up our momentum. **The runway to Election Day is running out fast, and we expect that Dr. Oz and his MAGA supporters will stop at**** _nothing_****to smear John with baseless attacks and lies all the way up until the end.**
John has been on the road to connect with voters all across PA’s 67 counties. **He’s fighting like hell for us, so it’s time we did the same for him.** It was your support that got us this far, and it’s your support that will get John to the Senate.
If you’re ready to fight for the future of working families in Pennsylvania and communities all over the U.S., now’s the time to step up. **[Help fuel our campaign in these final days with a contribution of $5 or more to help us reach our final GOTV goal and push this campaign to victory.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-1?refcode=em20221106-8084&refcode2=8084_434096_Dmh3Fa&akid=8084%2E434096%2EDmh3Fa)**
Thank you for believing in our movement.
Together,
Team Fetterman HQ

My Republican opponent Eric Toney supported the Gableman investigation.

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d2b4c228757c4918911d88d18505d951&_e=unXPgVlQu4jW7futWWTWjpWdQlmtkkIvV0wA8vroqZKhY3nDnQPZqOi1nSO4NS5pDy4cM_3n0oIp4hFPzlGiCDAuyxGJ_WZ9xt0aO6vaEjtyfMuBCRLN8tFQo_66DR9zBXA9boPBn6O6OWsiVRgJ5shXtWAv6VGfJkX6XKHz-SfuBNylVOciOBG_PMONCDH4ZMcqz5npwSUjCORpxCuYLHo-FPdMAWbDGksUndk4Vzf4VFhAtfi1E01K03N0-Q4odobB11F2duvT0DwO8m69JJrv-IC5gzkL2kFXdf8HrGheFsGKPzwdNJt1QCJnES_xL-1RMlCtC-dP3qM-NS9j4Wba-vqIFZPQDX9joeYaHxCE9P05X6USA6t-J-bZp1Wjmpz1Cv43W37X2tCD3-v1ProextclFYiyVsfbQY9iISg%3D "Johnson1")**_

body:
The good news is that our grassroots fundraising over the last few days has been record breaking.
| | |
---
Peter, it's Trudy. I just left a meeting with my team, and I've got good news and bad news.
**The good news is that our grassroots fundraising over the last few days has been _record breaking_.** I am so humbled and honored by this incredible outpouring of support for our campaign. You can build on this momentum by rushing a donation here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/tbv-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54190909/377675413/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNGM3MjVlZC0wNTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=18fQT6wJr48X8LW5DmXFeiG__9f5b5fIobtRiEPXWjE=)**
I know that politics and advocacy can feel pretty hopeless these days; it's tempting to just give up and tune out when you're faced with so much hatred, extremism, and cynicism. But I also know we can overcome these forces, which is why, in part, I am running for Senate in the first place. And I'm truly inspired to watch so many of you join my campaign, stand with me, and believe in a better future.
But like I said, I've got bad news too. **Despite all of the support we've been getting, we're still only 71% of the way to our urgent get-out-the-vote goal, and our midnight deadline is just a few hours away.**

With the election just TWO DAYS AWAY, this is our last chance to gather the grassroots resources it'll take to turn out voters on Election Day. We really can't fall short here.
I'll be straight with you: I can win this election – but not unless grassroots supporters like you stand with me during this final stretch. **So please, before my midnight deadline, will you rush a donation to help me win on Tuesday and bring compassion back to Washington?****Here's the best link to give:[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/tbv-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54190910/377675414/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNGM3MjVlZC0wNTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=18fQT6wJr48X8LW5DmXFeiG__9f5b5fIobtRiEPXWjE=)**
I'm so grateful to have you on this team.

Warmly,

Trudy

subject: This is blatant government overreach!
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._7CffEjv_9-eXtVrbBtcpA)
---
| | Dear Friend of Liberty,Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It's not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It's because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here's the kicker. The Sacketts' land is not wet. There's no water on it!Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn't comply with the EPA's outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_!The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights-**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach.That's why I'm emailing you today with a special request. I'm hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today.If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there's no telling who could be next.But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA's blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** For Liberty!Cristen WohlgemuthPresident & CEOMountain States Legal Foundation

And if the couple doesn't comply with the EPA's outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 per day!The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights-and yours. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach.That's why I'm emailing you today with a special request. I'm hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today.If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there's no telling who could be next.But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA. I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett. I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens. I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA's blatant government overreach. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6724ee55cd164ef4bbd5afb9982ed54f&_e=-oq8sgptX1GscWXdBuJFb1BOsI57V3LS_u9SO4WzhkyCaV2VNULJDZxIqHoSSr_r9KyYOVQtK3Nv0GfVKRgBAF6-dtoeIzviXA-KFl2x91XZeQsN2pG01VflSUvCP7INWgbczYWtyuVWFSmEdA1_tyxQATL5wQFAJzO5f0pemrld1FO9_QOdS1EizBIhXyRgSnb6bXpjG00M2N-EdeCAKUwGmz7QbTEWbHNVeDdbEx-Lz38oJhU7AzyooNC3Fw6EgzfcEKglYT5s0FDGzicbWEXeXWDdfFs61qn4iWBN4JN0lPePd-A7AyZq9xVRjKFWTy_mIbufxorPWdvAEsM-57-v3-h5m6Fu0jzfnngnLjiXUCpA5pEI8lQae6Uc8jNnctj2sgNJ0Pjegqn_MPHbLw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6724ee55cd164ef4bbd5afb9982ed54f&_e=-oq8sgptX1GscWXdBuJFb1BOsI57V3LS_u9SO4WzhkyCaV2VNULJDZxIqHoSSr_r9KyYOVQtK3Nv0GfVKRgBAF6-dtoeIzviXA-KFl2x91XZeQsN2pG01VflSUvCP7INWgbczYWtyuVWFSmEdA1_tyxQATL5wQFAJzO5f0pemrld1FO9_QOdS1EizBIhXyRgSnb6bXpjG00M2N-EdeCAKUwGmz7QbTEWbHNVeDdbEx8_-JEg2V60r7OcS8ZXuyqgt6dSMxqEWr7Czu4Z0hqNxki8N0bc0lYE8LSc7hUMg8mVCv9cnzNfV-b2KExc4EP9e6tmzx0gmD5JEg3GnRbJqdcvLfmqLmyRTgsxncfq5rGEzfhgSizlkYg_kQqPkYBO4pZdDWQM11zaWRDQ1_fyLQ%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6724ee55cd164ef4bbd5afb9982ed54f&_e=-oq8sgptX1GscWXdBuJFb1BOsI57V3LS_u9SO4WzhkyCaV2VNULJDZxIqHoSSr_r9KyYOVQtK3Nv0GfVKRgBAF6-dtoeIzviXA-KFl2x91XZeQsN2pG01VflSUvCP7INWgbczYWtyuVWFSmEdA1_tyxQATL5wQFAJzO5f0pemrld1FO9_QOdS1EizBIhXyRgSnb6bXpjG00M2N-EdeCAKUwGmz7QbTEWbHNVeDdbEx9bBucEA7e9F42Zywb-bRZkJTpK1wPmcxeE_Oruu5CCPCxYtyB6nQFaI76Zfo0V4earxu_Z7pxAHOiJRsFaNh665O0fPlsE5OfJyYzWcQ-NB-chhqnBf95OVjowrMrN2z7PJ-EjRCTtFOJyItenscqh0CB-SGjZ0qZA07eiTXvr9A%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Hi,
It’s Kevin with Dr. Bob Lorinser for Congress.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/octad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/octad]
Our current representative is working against the people of Northern Michigan and the UP. On Tues. Nov. 8, Jack Bergman must be replaced. We have just three days. Dr. Bob needs all of us to come out in droves on Election Day. Can we count on you?
MORE ABOUT DOC [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/octad]

Our district is facing out-of-control childcare costs, a housing shortage, a lack of healthcare and mental health services, a lack of jobs, and a severe need to improve our VA for Veterans.
Our current representative, Jack Bergman, has not offered any meaningful solutions to address these issues in his six years in office.
Dr. Bob Lorinser evaluates problems differently – by looking for the root cause of the issue like he would when he was a family physician. Preventative care is the best approach to fixing the issues we see today, and that requires new leadership in Congress.
Bob Lorinser has spent his career working across the political divide to get results that work for everyone.
Here's an example - what Doc said today about healthcare:
Alcoholism causes one in five American deaths and the US has the highest rate of drug overdoses in the world. Over 125 citizens die by suicide every day, and 20% of Americans suffer from mental health conditions.
Mental healthcare is healthcare and Michigan's 1st District is struggling without rural resources and services.
We need a doctor in the House. I intend to lead this fight at home and across the Nation.
Can Dr. Bob Lorinser count on your vote this November?
Thank you for your consideration and generosity,
-Kevin

body:
One thing you should know about me is that I’m a straight shooter. I call it like I see it.
#

Hi there -
One thing you should know about me is that I’m a straight shooter. I call it like I see it. My team, my family, and my friends will all tell you this. I value honesty and transparency, and these are the values we’ve built our campaign on since the very beginning of this race.
I hope you know that I don’t make these asks lightly. But I want to be direct right off the bat and let you know that [**I’m reaching out to ask you to contribute to my campaign for U.S. Senate before polls close on Tuesday, November 8th.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221106-1-ma&t=1&akid=2248%2E357359%2EDzgnNy)
I’m ready to be your next U.S. Senator. I promise I will always put our children and families first, and I will fight to ensure every person in America has the opportunity to thrive that they deserve.
And I won’t mince words when I tell you this: My opponent does not have our best interests at heart. He supports a national abortion ban without exceptions, has voted against lowering prescription drug costs, and voted against certifying the 2020 election results — even after the horrific acts that took place at the Capitol on January 6th.
Ted Budd’s views are _entirely_ out of step with North Carolinians’ values. Now, we have just two days left to ensure that voters across the state will get out and cast their ballots before polls close on Tuesday night. Our rights, our livelihoods, and our futures depend on flipping this Senate seat blue.
I’m asking if you can please join the hundreds of thousands of others who have donated to this campaign by making your first online contribution today. Time is running out to turn out voters, and your support would mean the world to me to help me in this final push before Election Day comes to a close.

subject: My story in pictures

body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6943fe7dab5f4d928c0c502d8bb86db0&_e=6hwSEwneRvgCIPssWjNEicft1yTdeWH5QIH3LlD8fnjXXeIHrfn1nLk7bVQ--4jRJy-VdYrvCH-AEjV5S6-iXWfZ5J6CDJUMRnR9EgWwC5oOA_CK7KQC7qiqAjefo0fyYFnplCgnKJ3QGG_XlrbNUn88dDIpKa6L7MbufBUkfjmbnwKiuGjRpcA4mZlhW-583W-bU56b3_F-OhDn_dHuYEkr4mNb7P8lAfTWHZSwdTCw75WYpDAqSY6vYQoW78Kddt7yzJSTuPhun-ZhJ_YCMD1s5FNmkUvdsVEKZxVV839d4LQUJrkmrBI5ctVbwoLqAi0G_-iYT5iSUUPoRCwIwBbwK7xJvKEiqWACZm8Lcfbf4j-xdibn04JQWhH9tu2aV0kVbHt5SElBSCHH0Ejm3hs8tUDHgb2ugxbuoA8ZwaIEBUlRrKlxJJWehFE0uF90 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6943fe7dab5f4d928c0c502d8bb86db0&_e=6hwSEwneRvgCIPssWjNEicft1yTdeWH5QIH3LlD8fnjXXeIHrfn1nLk7bVQ--4jRJy-VdYrvCH-AEjV5S6-iXWfZ5J6CDJUMRnR9EgWwC5oOA_CK7KQC7qiqAjefo0fyYFnplCgnKJ3QGG_XlrbNUn88dDIpKa6L7MbufBUkfjmbnwKiuGjRpcA4mZlhW-583W-bU56b3_F-OhDn_dHuYEkr4mNb7P8lAfTWHZSwdTCw75WYpDAqSY6vYQoW78Kddt7yzJSTuPhun-ZhJ_YCMD1s5FNmkUvdsVEKZxVV838rbJ6_e-MlDpWMnsdmTndX6Q7CN7lnoOmCti2Luk67DNtk05FvXzYsPJVifhDgz1FZoAD1FVg2VrwjPf1OIC_XUE1kZxuNF4teh7d7-SjNSq01cQ8ElrFFxdtl6diw4bIQOcZibGgWNGV3f1M3wlBT "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6943fe7dab5f4d928c0c502d8bb86db0&_e=6hwSEwneRvgCIPssWjNEicft1yTdeWH5QIH3LlD8fnjXXeIHrfn1nLk7bVQ--4jRJy-VdYrvCH-AEjV5S6-iXWfZ5J6CDJUMRnR9EgWwC5oOA_CK7KQC7qiqAjefo0fyYFnplCgnKJ3QGG_XlrbNUn88dDIpKa6L7MbufBUkfjmbnwKiuGjRpcA4mZlhW-583W-bU56b3_F-OhDn_dHuYEkr4mNb7P8lAfTWHZSwdTCw75WYpDAqSY6vYQoW78Kddt7yzJSTuPhun-ZhJ_YCMD1s5FNmkUvdsVEKZxVV839SKAJgpYae_89DEhuL52RZSYX6F7P-JXpDT-PAiSVqgcCxgk0MLIp_U4bKWyTwp7eh8rJM4uDttTIg06dJG7q052Yq_uTbmptS3RIR7OyPZizKqQatNYdE5KxVGqgoEtlGE2KGH_sAJkchwkYB-rBt "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6943fe7dab5f4d928c0c502d8bb86db0&_e=6hwSEwneRvgCIPssWjNEicft1yTdeWH5QIH3LlD8fnjXXeIHrfn1nLk7bVQ--4jRJy-VdYrvCH-AEjV5S6-iXWfZ5J6CDJUMRnR9EgWwC5oOA_CK7KQC7qiqAjefo0fyYFnplCgnKJ3QGG_XlrbNUn88dDIpKa6L7MbufBUkfjmbnwKiuGjRpcA4mZlhW-583W-bU56b3_F-OhDn_dHuYEkr4mNb7P8lAfTWHZSwdTCw75WYpDAqSY6vYQoW78Kddt7yzJSTuPhun-ZhJ_YCMD1s5FNmkUvdsVEKZxVV839TJ3Tzlnoy1GUqSIyGeogxlMNQofLPbPj-pZfFwBgV8r4zb0vaSjuR0gtfHBVQMTjyN_fJJ_sdAGQdjGQuwEOlFr2CeCOjk-f8ekFoCpGPLR9Wx7-HUMwI2l4qR5Uqy35mnZVlBCp5H33OHqIoBvbq "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

Team,
Somehow, Election Day is just 2 days away (we can’t believe it either).
This is one of the most competitive (and most expensive) House races in the country. As such, we’re preparing for anything and we wanted to give you a preview of what Election Night could look like.
We’ve always known this election is going to be close. In fact, it’s so close that we are unlikely to know the results on Election Night , as tabulating absentee ballots (which are really a third of our votes!) takes quite a bit of time. In 2020, our race was called at 7:00 am the next morning. This race could take 24 hours or more.
So, if you don’t see results right away – don’t panic! We’re going to be working through the night as numbers come in, and we’ll make sure to keep you in the know once we have results.
Thank you for being along for the ride with us. We’re doing everything we can right now to ensure voters get to the polls on or before November 8th. If you want to help us continue to get out the vote in the new 7th district, click below to make a contribution. body:
I just got out of an emergency meeting with my team
| It's Val Demings, and I just made a really tough call.

I just got out of an emergency meeting with my team, and they told me this: Marco Rubio has spent $15.7 million on TV ads this year, and a recent poll shows me 1 point behind. **The bottom line is that I need to counter GOP spending with ads of my own - _immediately._**

I talked through our options with my team, and I ended up making a really difficult decision: **I approved a new ad buy to reach undecided voters over the next 2 days - even though we don't have the budget yet.**

I had no other choice here. Races in Florida are always decided by razor-thin margins, so running just one more round of ads could help me reach just enough voters to win. I can't afford to play it safe - not when Senate control is on the line and our race is this tight.

**I know it's not ideal to spend the money before we raise it, but I have faith in this grassroots team. I took a gamble that we could raise $75,000 before midnight to cover the cost of our new ads - _and now, I'm counting on your support._** [Please: This race could decide which party wins Senate control, so I'm counting on every Democrat to help me close this budgeting gap. Team —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. But I refuse to let them win.
I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — will you split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton if you agree? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221106_MK_split]
I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — if you agree, will you split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221106_MK_split]
Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.
I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is. Chip in $20 or more today, split between my campaign and Seth Moulton, if you’re ready to help me win re-election and defend our majority >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221106_MK_split]
I’ll never back down from doing what’s right.
Thank you for staying in the fight with me,
Mark

Do you know what Kansans are saying about Derek Schmidt? We wanted to take the opportunity to share with you what real Kansans are saying about Derek. Trump, we care about what real Kansans have to say. | | |
---
| | Friend,**

** Do you know what Kansans are saying about Derek Schmidt? We wanted to take the opportunity to share with you what **real Kansans** are saying about Derek. Over the past week, we’ve been highlighting why Derek is the right choice for Governor but more than the endorsements from key players like the late former Senator Bob Dole and President Donald J. Trump, we care about what real Kansans have to say. Here are just a few of the things Kansans are saying: _ "When our country does not have safe and secure borders, all 50 of our states are border states. A strong law and order governor is what I propose for this border state. Kelly was the right choice four years ago and I endorsed her. Schmidt is who Kansas needs at this time." _ **-David Powls, Editor and Publisher, Holton Recorder** _"We believe Kansas can do better, and that can only happen with Derek Schmidt as governor." -_**Earl Watt, Publisher, Liberal Leader & Times** “Derek Schmidt, I’ve got to think, is just the man to do it. I’ve known him since his days as a legislator, someone who was always committed to what we call good government and especially to the people’s right to know what their government is doing. He’s always impressed me as genuine, someone whose heart was in the right place and who cared about things like open government. He carried that commitment over to the attorney general’s office, where in 12 years he conducted training sessions across the state for public officials on open meetings and open records laws. It’d be a pleasure to see him apply his personality and his principles to reforming and rebuilding state government.” **-Steve Haynes, Publisher of Colby Free Press, Goodland Star-News, Oberlin Herald, Norton Telegram, Saint Francis Herald, Bird City Times, and Country Advocate** “Schmidt will right Gov. Kelly’s wrongs. The Republican Party in Kansas had unified under the banner of Derek Schmidt, our current Kansas Attorney General. Gov. Kelly has given Kansans another reminder that our state is not at its best with a Democrat in the lead office. Our state’s motto seems appropriate for this race – Derek Schmidt will be our “ad astra” after Gov. Kelly’s “per aspera.” Join me in supporting Derek Schmidt for governor and help put Kansas back on the right path.” **-Dan Thalman, Editor and Publisher of Washington County News** **We hope you will join us and Kansans from across the state in supporting Derek this Election Day and chip in $25 right now to show your support →[https://secure.winred.com/schmidt-for-kansas/contribute](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=a0e7fc0a55e7466fbb7355d15b53cbd4&_e=23VDDcgdJ8EThnLcsk48tihzQmHdB_AZ4l-oER9EViFVuNnce6lqgg_Zu-MIFom2S09A7Ko3cMkgdf8ndsvgUoA1NyOkFLAQL5svWRE7GlFVEIXCf-7yD1qLjE2d39ad26RROT-s4R_laJTJFSzFY7d76LpQQiTPoGmATRN4DtBpsV7t_11TT0CWZHjO3vqkXyhHNyG19OfSFS95qQu60iZ8YUO5hEMP76TsL7rZ_khZEwufaIQUT6SP-xYbwyMWVEOlQfEabt-cMAoG0BLSwiAZUUEH2ybirfIs_aG82ldhhLzU0Xm7SS0H5lMlfhgJ905vfCB-1XfMJe94lnBF2wT79igS4S2HZK5-CwB_46csQGM6tEuxTAtRgFg6TmCDSFeseZUzbqlqjsRKGm_ciHT4fKpBF8Or_x_rrKhC4DkL8-V8aCM6WTcXz15U-VQUAuYN_TLRBy59mVFchIwYVg%3D%3D)** Thank you, Team Schmidt

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

**Derek, I’m humbled and honored to be running for Governor of Pennsylvania. The general election is almost over — [will you join us, and donate $5 right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54195344/377696925/360385765?refcode=email_110622_resendmyrecord_allactives&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=0f2fc470-1a5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjJmYzQ3MC0xYTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BvYMwKhki3LIuadGo6gj9uwMVddWYavPf-6jdGaAoCA=)** I’m a Pennsylvanian. I was raised here, and my wife Lori and I are raising our four kids just a few miles down the road from where I grew up. I’ve spent my career serving the people of our Commonwealth, as a State Representative, a County Commissioner, and now as the People’s Attorney General. We need all hands on deck to hold on to Pennsylvania in just two days, and I’m ready to work hard with this team to make it happen. **During this campaign and as your next Governor, I’m going to take my cues from people in places like West Philly and Washington County — not from special interests in Washington, DC or big corporations trying to screw over Pennsylvanians. Because I’m not working for them — I’m working for you.** **[If you’re with me in this fight to protect our democracy, defend our rights, and keep Pennsylvania in Democratic hands — can you pitch in $5 today to our Defenders of Democracy Fund?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54195345/377696926/360385765?refcode=email_110622_resendmyrecord_allactives&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=0f2fc470-1a5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjJmYzQ3MC0xYTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BvYMwKhki3LIuadGo6gj9uwMVddWYavPf-6jdGaAoCA=)** We’re facing unprecedented challenges here in Pennsylvania, but I’ve taken on the big fights for the communities we call home — delivering for working families and holding special interests and bad actors accountable. I’ve spent my career taking on the big and powerful, whether it was taking on well-connected corporate interests to protect health care for nearly two million Western Pennsylvanians, holding accountable predator priests to get justice for survivors after decades of sexual abuse and cover-ups, or standing up to Trump’s election lies in the courtroom to protect our democracy. As Pennsylvania’s Governor, I’ll keep taking on those big fights. I’ll fight to defend your right to vote, I’ll fight to defend access to abortion, and I’ll fight to defend our democracy — right here in the birthplace of our nation. **[Can I count on you to join this important fight? Make a donation of any amount now to our Defenders of Democracy Fund to support my campaign for Governor as we wrap up the general election.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54195346/377696927/360385765?refcode=email_110622_resendmyrecord_allactives&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=0f2fc470-1a5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjJmYzQ3MC0xYTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BvYMwKhki3LIuadGo6gj9uwMVddWYavPf-6jdGaAoCA=)** This is going to be one hell of a fight — but with you, I know we can win in just two days. name: Wade Herring
subject: Promises Kept.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Wade Herring for Congress
body:
https://www.wadeherringforcongress.com/ [https://www.wadeherringforcongress.com/]
Peter,
We have been hard at work on this campaign for over 17 months, and now we are in the final days.
After the insurrection on January 6th and Rep. Buddy Carter’s vote to try and overturn the 2020 election, I felt compelled to run for everyone in the First District. When I started on this journey, my team and I made a series of promises to ourselves regarding our goals, philosophy, and mission:
Be Rational, Not Radical . My goal is to be a listener, a learner, and a problem solver. When I explained this during the debates, Carter stated that I did not know how Washington worked. Carter has co-sponsored legislation that would criminalize abortion, he voted against lowering healthcare and prescription drug costs, and he is working to take away our Medicare and Social Security. I pledge to find solutions to the problems that face our District, not simply point fingers and play politics.
Involve Young People. Our campaign office has been filled with high schoolers and college students eager to learn and work for a change. Our TikTok account has millions of views and has been recognized both locally and nationally for how it has connected us to the younger generation. The youth are our future and deserve to be a part of decisions that impact them longer than anyone else.
Raise Money And Raise Attention. This campaign has raised $1.3 million from over 2,400 individual donors. We are meeting voters where they are; in the community, over the phone, on TV, radio, social media, via billboards, flyers, and the like. We have made headlines everywhere – from local newspapers to Georgia public radio, to national media.
Campaign in ALL 15 Counties. GA-01 stretches over 120 miles north to south, and then another 100 inland. In March, folks in all 15 counties banded together to create the 3-day barnstorm known as the Wade Parade. Since we started this campaign, I have been in all 15 counties on multiple occasions – showing up to community events, meetings, and town halls beyond the Chatham-Savannah area and making sure to be present throughout the urban AND rural parts of this District.
Build People Up, Not Tear Them Down . People from all walks of life have formed ‘Wade Brigades’ to help support the campaign in their respective communities, from people of color, veterans, seniors, youth, Democrats, Independents, and Republicans alike – to better understand their issues and concerns. This campaign is about bringing people together, doing the right thing, and finding ways to help each other – not creating factions and divisions.
Work Harder. The Carter campaign may have certain advantages - the power of the incumbency, a $1.5 million fundraising headstart, and more, BUT hard work is part of who I am and a cornerstone of our campaign. Our ground game, field efforts, voter outreach, and volunteerism has been unmatched.
I am proud of the work this campaign has done in our community, the coalition we have built, and the promises we have kept.
In these final days, we’re doing the most we can to drive up voter turnout. If you can, please pitch in today to our Final Stretch Fund to help us finish strong . [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadefinalstretch?refcode=whem1106]
Onwards to Election Day on November 8th – let’s get this done!
Thank you for your support,
Wade Herring

body:
Corporate money isn’t our thing.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221106-3583-header&t=1&akid=3583%2E2526796%2Ed7IWR7)
“Money talks.”
It’s an old adage that unfortunately rings very true in the world of politics. While most of the campaigns ahead of us accept corporate money, Alexandria refuses to take special interest money and relies exclusively on grassroots donations. That we're still the #1 small-dollar funded campaign is a testament to our movement’s strength — and it’s truly only possible thanks to all of you.
We’re asking for your help to keep Alexandria as a top fundraiser so that we not only have the resources to carry out our plans, but also to help our priorities and policies get the legitimacy they deserve.
[So what do you say? Can you pitch in — $3, $15, $50 — whatever you can to help us get out the vote to keep Alexandria in Congress in these last 48 hours before Election Day?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221106-2.POWcGS&refcode=em20221106-3583-P_FND_ANO_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3583%2E2526796%2Ed7IWR7)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221106-2.POWcGS&refcode=em20221106-3583-P_FND_ANO_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3583%2E2526796%2Ed7IWR7)**
If we had our way, we’d have public financing of campaigns and not have to raise millions of dollars to defend against dark money attacks.
If money talks, then we want our money to come from bartenders and teachers and nurses, not corporate CEOs. And we want to raise as much as we can to show our strength and have the resources to build our movement as big as possible.
Thank you for reading and for all of your support. We’re very grateful.
See you at the finish line,
Team AOC

**Peter,**

This is hard for me to write.

It's Marco Rubio, and I just can't believe that there is more support for a Trump Impeachment Manager than for a strong Conservative leader.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
https://www.kpef.info [https://www.kpef.info]

Dear Friend,

I'm sure you've seen a lot recently about voters deciding between abortion rights or the economy, as if voters need to choose! No, this election is about both abortion rights AND the economy because legal access to abortion is absolutely an economic issue.

You cannot have economic freedom without reproductive freedom. And in Pennsylvania, abortion rights and access in this state will be determined by who we vote for on Election Day, Nov. 8, 2022.

On an individual level, pregnant people need to be able to afford or access health insurance for pre- and postnatal care. Postpartum parents need paid time off from work to recover and support their infants.

But we know that not everyone has health care coverage and Pennsylvania does not require employers to provide paid leave. We also know that people who cannot access abortion when they want or need to have a higher chance of living in poverty and having poorer health outcomes.

And in terms of the economy, a recent study by the Pennsylvania Budget and Policy Center [https://krc-pbpc.org/wp-content/uploads/CostOfAbortionBan-1.pdf] (PBPC) found that a total abortion ban in Pennsylvania would likely reduce wages in the state by $10 billion per year.

We MUST vote for abortion rights champions this election. Our freedoms, our futures, and our economy depend on it.

Please vote. And help Keystone Progress turn out the progressive vote next Tuesday.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=110622kp2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=110622kp2]

See you at the polls!

Laura

body:
This is the most consequential mid-term election in our lifetime.
#
Peter,
I’m about to ask you to make a contribution to Patty Murray. But first, let me explain why it’s so important that Washington State sends her back to the Senate.
This is the most consequential mid-term election in our lifetime. It’s about making sure that women can control their own bodies. It’s about combating climate change. It’s about whether we retain the foundations of American democracy.
But, at a time when the very rich are getting richer while millions of working class families are falling behind, it’s also about the economy. Do we create an economy that works for all, or just wealthy campaign contributors and the 1%?
We are facing massive income and wealth inequality, a global pandemic, the existential threat of climate change and major attacks against our democratic foundations. And it has never been more important to elect leaders who will stand up to large corporations and billionaires and make sure we build an economy that works for working people.
**That’s why we need leaders like Patty Murray.** Patty has always been a partner in the Senate in the fight to raise the wage, defend workers’ rights, and create a more fair economy. And right now, she is counting on you to support her re-election campaign during these final days before Election Day.
**[Can you contribute $5 to Patty Murray’s campaign today? It is very important that we send Patty back to the Senate to help continue our struggle for justice.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54197332/377706046/-452802895?refcode=pm_em_221106_2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODM1MDljMS0yNjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4UzGSuFfuI_RhXCsA96SLuO1M7KP2k5X_5aWlJggGeU=)**
Today, we live in an economy in which the billionaires are getting much richer while working families fall further behind.
Unbelievably, while 60 percent of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck, we now have more income and wealth inequality than we have ever had in the history of our country – with three multi-billionaires owning more wealth than the bottom half of Americans. While employers squeeze workers and their unions for cuts to health care and other benefits, the CEOs of major corporations now make nearly 400 times more than their average employees – the largest employer-worker gap in our history.
Right now, more than any time in modern history, we need leaders in the Senate who have the courage to take on the wealthy campaign contributors, super PACs, and lobbyists who work overtime in protecting the interests of billionaires and corporate interests.
That is why I am asking you to support Patty Murray’s re-election campaign today. It is up to all of us to stand with Patty during these final days before Election Day.
**[We need to keep Patty in the Senate. Please make a $5 contribution now to make sure she gets re-elected and can keep fighting for working people not just in Washington, but across the country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54197333/377706047/-452802895?refcode=pm_em_221106_2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODM1MDljMS0yNjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4UzGSuFfuI_RhXCsA96SLuO1M7KP2k5X_5aWlJggGeU=)**
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

| | Reject Mississippi's status quo
Vote for change on Tuesday, Nov. 8
---
| | Dear fellow Mississippians, As a resident of Mississippi, you know change is needed now more than ever. In the 2022 State Democracy Report Card, the status quo is as bad as it gets: “Mississippi has the second worst democracy in the nation and the worst voting laws in the nation. It received a failing grade in every category. Mississippi has resisted making any improvements to its democratic systems.”* Here are just a few facts about the present situation, the status quo, in our state:
* Resisted pandemic-era voting expansions like vote-by-mail and early voting.
* The only state to offer Election Day as the only voting option in 2020.
* Passed a racially gerrymandered congress on the map, and a panel of federal judges refused to rule on its constitutionality.
* Eliminated our right to petition the government through the ballot initiative process
* Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch signed onto Texas’ lawsuit to overturn the results of the 2020 election.
* Representative Trent Kelly voted to not certify the presidential election.

Do you want Mississippi to continue to be the second-worst democracy in the nation? ...when enough of us are sufficiently miserable and fed up with the status quo, a state of affairs clearly evident in recent polling.— Time, 20 Oct. 2022 If you are fed up with the status quo, which is the present situation in Mississippi, you should consider voting on November 8, 2022, and encouraging friends, colleagues and family to vote. We are gearing up for the last days of campaigning here in North Mississippi. Voters have access to a [sample ballot](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/77OHE6zny/c?w=iYhoXtaaFvr2WSY7IDxgZwXIlGkV391ySrpEMPPqOKE.)** for each of the 21 counties in the First Congressional District to see who is running for office on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, and prepare their vote. TWO Days Left Before Election Day
* [Review your sample ballot](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/77OHE6zny/c?w=8XUpzniQMfF_a4gXxW67E8oh8UsQ7LkGO0PPEkeWMPE.). Look at the sample ballot for your county to learn who is running in your election.
* [Locate your polling place](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/77OHE6zny/c?w=IyqTJW4rL0lXp9TXLG1QDnMTOEdxyuSLqGXGXKkZL2Q.).

HELP Support Our Get Out the Vote campaignDonate to support Dianne's Get Out of the Vote, which helps the campaign connect with potential voters to get them to the polls. You can donate to Dianne's campaign through [ActBlue](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/77OHE6zny/c?w=Wuyn4nCt4RLp5unIi-oWcEWNu_3U3m_EH8R6NBhfC7g.). Volunteer by contacting us at [DianneBlackforCongress@gmail.com](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/77OHE6zny/c?w=fBU-LoguKHLtjgDKLzM1XP35IF5Y4C46OX8N67s2ZMg.). Thank you for your support,Dianne Black for Congress Grateful to be endorsed by Indivisible, the Mississippi Federation of Democratic Women, and Indivisible NEMS **Source: [https://endcitizensunited.org/2022-state-democracy-report-card/](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/77OHE6zny/c?w=iyYNvTXhAyClpGq4qoLuCgf0MM5wEwq0K76Wr4PkKGg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9lbmRjaXRpemVuc3VuaXRlZC5vcmcvMjAyMi1zdGF0ZS1kZW1vY3JhY3ktcmVwb3J0LWNhcmQvIiwiciI6IjIyZWVmN2Q4LTAzNjktNDIwYy03YjYzLTZlY2ZhN2NlYzc2OSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6ImQ0ODdlYmZmLWQ3ZjUtNGFlYi1hZGIzLTFhZmNkMzc1NTliZiJ9)End Citizens United Action Fund and Let America Vote Acton Fund**Note: Each sample ballot provided is a compilation of all candidates running in all elections in that county, created to help residents plan their vote. He's riling up his base
| | | **I have an urgent update, friend: Donald Trump is holding his final 2022 Florida rally _tonight_.**

Republicans are terrified that their grip on Florida is in serious danger: It's why our state is the target for one of Trump's last rallies. CNN is calling Marco Rubio one of the most vulnerable senators in the country – and Florida Senate races come down to the margin of error (0.12 points in the last race).

Trump is riling up his base because we're building the momentum to win – **and the GOP is desperate to keep this seat red because Florida could determine Senate control.**

I have a major tailwind at my back because of grassroots donors like you, friend – but experts long ago predicted this could be the most expensive Senate race _ever_. And Trump, Mitch McConnell and GOP outside groups are pouring millions into this race and pulling out every trick in the book to defeat me.

**I can't stand up to the millions of dollars that the GOP is throwing behind Marco Rubio alone. If I'm going to win in Florida and defend and expand our Senate majority, I need this grassroots team to step up right now. Tonight's rally proves it.**

body:
If my opponent wins, he’ll be helping Mitch McConnell and the GOP bring our party to a standstill, and we can’t let that happen.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1191%2E61531%2EcWvIvm)
Hello,
Now that we’re just two days away from the election, we need All Hands On Deck — now more than ever.
National Republicans — including Steve Bannon, Mitch McConnell, and even Donald Trump — are supporting my opponent and working to win this seat so they can regain the majority. We can’t let that happen.
We currently have a knife’s edge Senate, split 50/50. McConnell and the GOP have been angling for a return to power since the second they lost it, and if he becomes the Majority Leader again, there’s no chance we advance the progressive agenda our country needs for its future. If my opponent wins in two days, he’ll be helping McConnell and the rest of their party give more tax cuts to the rich at the expense of working families.
[**The Senate is up for grabs, and our race in Vermont is being closely monitored by Republicans all across the country. If you’re able, please chip in $3 or more right away so we have what it takes to fight back and win.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4980?t=3&akid=1191%2E61531%2EcWvIvm)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

I firmly believe in working across the aisle and finding common ground with your political opponents, but that’s proven to be a challenge when Mitch McConnell’s in power.
I’ve watched good bill after good bill pass the House only to die in the Senate because McConnell’s been more concerned with maintaining his party’s control over our government than following the will of the American people.
We’ve all watched him use the filibuster to gum up our democracy, abusing his power even while he’s in the minority. He can’t be trusted to be Majority Leader again, and I believe this grassroots movement has the strength to ensure that doesn’t happen.
[**Election Day will be here in exactly two days, and I don’t want us leaving anything to chance. Can you help power this team to victory with a $3 contribution or more right away?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4980?t=7&akid=1191%2E61531%2EcWvIvm)

Peter

Team,

Nearly two years ago, my husband Joe lead us on a journey towards healing our country. Since then, he’s delivered results again and again. Together, we’ve been able to pass historic legislation that has benefited millions of Americans. I’m so incredibly proud.

In order to keep building on our progress, we must first protect our democracy from unprecedented attacks. And that starts with electing Democratic Secretaries of State who will protect the integrity of our elections.

Across the nation, voters are casting their ballots for Secretary of State, the top official in charge of election laws. Secretaries of State make decisions about when, where, and how folks vote — and they’re responsible for certifying the election results.

[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=em_fr_110622_b4_JILLBIDEN_30AC&amount=5]

Team: the polls are tight in swing states like Arizona and Nevada, and Republicans who denied the legitimacy of the last election have a real shot at winning next Tuesday. We can’t let that happen.

My friends at the Democratic Association of Secretaries of State are working around the clock to get out the vote and elect pro-democracy candidates this Tuesday. With their help, we can fend off attacks on our democracy, but these efforts take massive financial resources.

That’s why I’m asking you to make a generous donation to the DASS so we can defend our democracy and our sacred right to vote. Please, chip in anything you can now. >>

Jill Biden

| | | | | **Cliff’s Note:** **Per _CBS News_ polling, "If November’s election sees a big turnout of young voters and voters of color...the Battleground Tracker predicts Democrats hold onto the majority by a single seat..." If not, we lose 10-15 seats, and the House, where Marjorie Taylor Greene will promptly push for Joe Biden's impeachment. _We can't let this happen_. Like the Kansas abortion referendum, younger voters will determine if it does. Please keep this in mind as you read Mark Hamill's urgent plea below to support _Voters of Tomorrow_ , as they register every last voter in states like Colorado--where Lauren Boebert's in danger of losing her seat--that allow voter registration through Election Day.** [**Our Blue Amp community has raised over $9,000 to support Voters of Tomorrow already, and we're so grateful for your faith in the next generation of voters!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T75445a55-8c1c-452d-81e4-5878a0708d59/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T602daac0-01fe-4267-a292-82a8018e732d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dear Peter, **Voters of Tomorrow, has a simple plan: Educate, register, and mobilize young voters so they can have a voice in the next election. Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18%, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only 2 days away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through election day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. Can you rush a donation right now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38a8536b-b6c0-4337-ad16-77246df05509/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **A $22 donation = FIVE new voters registered! $44 and they can register TEN NEW VOTERS! Click the button below to chip in and join our fight ⇩⇩**

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey Abrams and I wanted to share a quick message with you before I get
back on the road.

For years, Brian Kemp and his allies have shown they will stop at nothing
to defeat us.

That’s why he’s enacted some of the harshest voter suppression laws in the
nation — to slow down our momentum.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221106_B2_IncomingMessage_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=18397%2E1862389%2ENwqv8n ]With less than 48 hours left before Election Day, we need your help to
overcome hurdles that Kemp and his allies have put in place before us.
Because while Brian Kemp is restricting voters, we’re working overtime to
get our final round of voters to the polls. Will you invest
$25 — or even $5 — in my campaign to help us
fund our mobilization efforts in the final hours before polls open on
Election Day?

Brian Kemp is working overtime to restrict voters because he doesn't have
any real plans to stand on,
Derek.

But despite his attempts to undermine us, we have a vision for Georgia’s
future that is worth fighting for.

We’re fighting for the student from Macon to get the financial aid they
need to go back to school.

We’re fighting for the mother of three from Augusta to go to the doctor
for the first time in years when she’s finally covered under Medicaid.

We’re fighting for the small business owner in Duluth to expand his
business when the state invests in him over huge corporations.

We’re fighting for everyday Georgians. But we can’t make that happen if
Brian Kemp undermines and silences our votes.

Stacey Abrams

**_Exactly 2 DAYS from today, we are going to WIN this race for Governor, because we HAVE to..._**

**_We are going to turn the thousands-strong rallies, the polls that have us within striking distance, the grassroots support that is out-raising Hochul 's powerful pay-to-play allies, and all of the incredible momentum on the ground into a historic victory that saves New York from being lost forever to constant attacks on our wallets, safety, freedom, and kids' education..._**
**BECAUSE LOSING IS _NOT_ AN OPTION!**

| In Kathy Hochul's New York, _law-abiding citizens are forced to live in fear ..._

Three children outside of Buffalo are now having to grow up without a mother, because she refuses to make essential changes to the cashless bail law.

Our streets and subways are being taken over by violent criminals, because she believes your concerns about rising crime are simply "conspiracy theories."

And every day, more and more innocent New Yorkers are becoming victims, because she refuses to look out for our safety and change her soft-on-crime, head in the sand approach to coddling criminals!
**_When you help me take Kathy Hochul 's job just 2 Days from now, that all changes._**
I will declare a Crime Emergency on Day 1, fire Woke DAs who refuse to enforce the law, take action to repeal cashless bail, and ensure that **_CRIMINALS_** are the ones forced to live in fear.

**This historic victory is within reach, friend. We have the potential to save LIVES on Tuesday.[_Are you ready to take our streets back and finally restore a great American state to GLORY? >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61805156:6fdALkGNR:m:1:3374012347:E9CC1B6DBAFA2D6B6598DD9F78E43794:r)**

Because even though so much is going our way, and Kathy Hochul has alienated herself not just with Republicans, but with Democrats and Independents as well- she is **_STILL_** getting last-minute, emergency support from a national **_Super PAC!_**

That means we need to go into an even higher gear and fight to the finish.
