body:
We can’t let the Republicans win and destroy everything we’ve built.
#
Peter,
**Two days from now** , voters will decide the results of THE most important election in recent history. It’s up to us to make sure the GOP doesn’t win.
Because, in all honesty, they could. The Republicans could win the House, the Senate, and statewide races. **We can’t stop every Republican running for Congress, but we CAN stop them from retaking control.** And we have to.
[**With just 2 days left until this critical election, I’m asking you to join me in this fight and chip in anything you can -- whether that’s $5 or more. Can I count on you, Peter?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22466?refcode=em20221106-1813&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1813%2E420207%2Emd2dcY)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22466?refcode=em20221106-1813&t=20&akid=1813%2E420207%2Emd2dcY)**
**The House Democratic majority is the #1 thing protecting us from the Republicans’ dangerous agenda.** I know exactly what they want to do if they regain control over the House, or the Senate, or both. They’ve been pretty clear about it:
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22466?refcode=em20221106-1813&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1813%2E420207%2Emd2dcY)
[**If, like me, you do NOT consent to a future governed by these Republicans, please support us with a donation in these final two days.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22466?refcode=em20221106-1813&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1813%2E420207%2Emd2dcY)
I wish I didn't have to spell it out, but since the Republicans clearly don’t agree...
_The right to get an abortion matters._
_The right to use contraception matters._
_The right to love and marry who you choose matters._
_The right to live in a safe, healthy environment matters._
**But they want to take it all away -- and in 2 days, they’re going to try.** It would be a disaster for our democracy and all of our hard-won victories. That’s why I’m committed to doing all I can to protect you from their dangerous agenda.
[**We’re doing everything in our power to support Democrats and hold the House. Will you help sustain us in these final 48 hours?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22466?refcode=em20221106-1813&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=1813%2E420207%2Emd2dcY)
Together, we can do this. Stay strong,
Pramila

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so frantically if this wasn’t a dire situation... | | Fellow American, I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so frantically if this wasn’t a dire situation ... but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is outraising my campaign and we’re days away from Election Day. Now is not the time to fall behind - too much is at stake in this election for us to lose. I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? REACH OUT TO YOU, Fellow American. If I win – Republicans will win back the Senate majority. If I lose - well, you know. We can’t let that happen. The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority. My campaign is being outraised and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race. Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. I’m counting on hearing from you. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

| **_But Grassley's changed over that time. He was in on Donald Trump's plot to overthrow our government--tweeting out on January 6th that he'd be certifying the electoral votes, not the Vice President. It was a lie. name: Jill & Matt Hartle
subject: Our Story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Annie Andrews for Congress
body:
| Hi,

Before last month, we’d never written a political email or told our personal stories at a press conference. We never imagined that would be our path, but this race made us feel like we had to speak out.

We always wanted kids. So when we learned we were pregnant, we were ecstatic. But that quickly changed to fear when we learned our baby girl, Ivy Grace, had a critical fetal anomaly.

We knew there was no hope, but under Nancy Mace’s 6 week abortion ban in South Carolina, there was nothing we could do.

That’s how we ended up flying hours to Washington D.C. to get a medical procedure we should've been able to get much closer to home. _Nancy Mace’s policies did that._

Look, we’re not Democrats. We usually keep out of really partisan politics. But this isn’t a matter of politics for our family or millions of other women—**it’s the difference between right and wrong.**

Nancy Mace, in drafting a 6 week abortion ban and supporting a federal ban with no exceptions and bans on IVF, is wrong.

To add insult to injury, when we told our story at the press conference with Annie, Nancy Mace sent a group of men to stand in the audience to jeer and laugh at us.

**[Now, with the election in just 2 days, we need you to join us in being on the right side of history. Click here to help Annie get-out-the-vote so she can defeat Mace on Election Day and fight for all of us in the Lowcountry as our representative.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54194836/377694838/-137966981?amount=15&source=em_nbi_aa_20221106_fr_2.7_0_6mo_hartle_na_na_gotv&refcode2=&contactdata=jJyf5Gg9e+K9KSltPL67/hh0onBwISGv252tGGFq+3WjAeSHLTSn8wqAnzVfiawB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGVlNjAxNS0xODVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VWcP3GX11aMeUN_KGxfjl52a6PWfHrUu-J1P4PMtcwA=)** | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

clean_body: | Hi, Before last month, we’d never written a political email or told our personal stories at a press conference. We never imagined that would be our path, but this race made us feel like we had to speak out. We always wanted kids. So when we learned we were pregnant, we were ecstatic. But that quickly changed to fear when we learned our baby girl, Ivy Grace, had a critical fetal anomaly. We knew there was no hope, but under Nancy Mace’s 6 week abortion ban in South Carolina, there was nothing we could do. That’s how we ended up flying hours to Washington D.C. to get a medical procedure we should've been able to get much closer to home. Nancy Mace’s policies did that. Look, we’re not Democrats. We usually keep out of really partisan politics. But this isn’t a matter of politics for our family or millions of other women—it’s the difference between right and wrong. Nancy Mace, in drafting a 6 week abortion ban and supporting a federal ban with no exceptions and bans on IVF, is wrong. Peter, I’ve been traveling around the district with the DFL to fire up voters to get to the polls on Election Day. And I have to tell you, the support has been overwhelming. I keep hearing the same thing across the district: Whether it’s knocking on doors, meeting with voters face-to-face, the DMs I receive on Twitter, and the email replies you’ve sent me, it’s become clear that Minnesotans are ready for a change.
---

---
They’re tired of the national embarrassment of having Tom Emmer representing them in Congress. They’re tired of having their rights ripped away from them and feeling hopeless about the future. **And they know I’m the fighter they need to protect our democracy, our rights, and our values as their next U.S. Representative.** **[So let’s keep fighting. We’re only three days away from Election Day, and every dollar we raise goes towards spreading the word that change is possible this election season. If you can, donate $5 today so we can keep up the fight through November 8.](http://clicksp.hendricks2022.com/f/a/evDiAkSz_UI4z7NNaN-gWQ~~/AAPPAAA~_ld71IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAIM~)**

Hi team -

It’s Senator Chris Murphy. I’m reaching out today because our democracy is facing unprecedented attacks.

Donald Trump and his acolytes have pushed conspiracy theories about the 2020 election being stolen.

Now, in swing states across the country, those same people actually want to be put in charge of running our elections and counting our votes.

Too many Republicans’ goal is to undermine our elections from the inside. They have made clear they are willing to tilt the scales in their favor – or even throw out the results of free and fair elections.

We must meet this moment and defend our democracy. And that starts with electing Democratic Secretaries of State who will protect the integrity of our elections.

Can I count on you to make a donation to The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State so we can defend our democracy and free and fair elections?

Chip in $5 >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=em_fr_110622_b3_CMURPH_30ac&amount=5]
Chip in $25 >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=em_fr_110622_b3_CMURPH_30ac&amount=25]

Chip in another amount >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22refcode=em_fr_110622_b3_CMURPH_30ac&amount=5]

Democratic Secretaries of State are the last line of defense to ensure the integrity of our elections. They safeguard our elections and make sure that when you go to the ballot box, your vote gets counted.

But now those same people who have been spreading lies about the last election are vying to control the next one. If they get their way, they could try to install Donald Trump as president even if we defeat him again in 2024.

The good news is my friends at The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State are working to elect candidates in critical swing states, like Arizona and Nevada, who will defend our democracy and ensure that our votes and our voices will be heard.

If we want to defend our democracy, we must preserve access to the ballot box. If we lose a single Secretary of State seat, the consequences could be catastrophic. Can we count on you to chip in today?

-James

God Bless America & Our Veterans
---
---
Dear Friends,
Today, I attended events in Norwalk and Stamford honoring our Veterans. We owe a debt of gratitude to our active and retired servicemembers and their families. We must always remember those that made the ultimate sacrifice to protect our nation.
I am the proud daughter, sister and niece of military members who served our country with purpose and pride. My father served in the Army during WWII, and his brother, Flight Officer Elmer Jackson, lost his life in the Allied Invasion of Sicily. My father-in-law survived 35 tail gunner missions during WWII. Retired Air Force Col. John C. Jackson III, my brother, dedicated 26 years of his life to our country. I’m deeply grateful for and honor all those who are willing to serve and protect the freedom we too often take for granted.
---
| |
---
|
---
**My decision to run for Congress was solidified on August 26, 2021... the day 13 U.S. service members lost their lives during the chaotic withdrawal from Afghanistan. We should never have let politics get in the way of the safety of our nation and our military.**
Sadly, this rushed departure means that thousands of Afghans who risked their lives to protect our troops are in danger. We must do all we can to help get them and their families out of Afghanistan and to safety.
As our pledge reminds us, we are “One Nation Under God, Indivisible, with Liberty and Justice for All”. Now, more than ever, these words serve both as a reminder of the greatness of the United States of America and as a call to action to stand together as the beacon of freedom our world needs now more than ever!
These are among the many reasons why I have chosen to run for U.S.Congress - to be in service to Connecticut’s Fourth District and for a brighter future.**In the important words of Former Navy SEAL, Senior Chief James Hatch, “if we truly wish to honor our Veterans, we must live life full and take care of one another and our great country.”**
I hope I have earned your trust and support.
God Bless America and our Veterans!
---
---

clean_body: | | | | I am the proud daughter, sister and niece of military members who served our country with purpose and pride. jaymestevensonforcongress.com God Bless America & Our Veterans Dear Friends, Today, I attended events in Norwalk and Stamford honoring our Veterans. We owe a debt of gratitude to our active and retired servicemembers and their families. We must always remember those that made the ultimate sacrifice to protect our nation. I am the proud daughter, sister and niece of military members who served our country with purpose and pride. My father served in the Army during WWII, and his brother, Flight Officer Elmer Jackson, lost his life in the Allied Invasion of Sicily. My father-in-law survived 35 tail gunner missions during WWII. Retired Air Force Col. John C. Jackson III, my brother, dedicated 26 years of his life to our country. I’m deeply grateful for and honor all those who are willing to serve and protect the freedom we too often take for granted. | | | My decision to run for Congress was solidified on August 26, 2021... the day 13 U.S. service members lost their lives during the chaotic withdrawal from Afghanistan. We should never have let politics get in the way of the safety of our nation and our military. Sadly, this rushed departure means that thousands of Afghans who risked their lives to protect our troops are in danger. We must do all we can to help get them and their families out of Afghanistan and to safety. As our pledge reminds us, we are “One Nation Under God, Indivisible, with Liberty and Justice for All”. Now, more than ever, these words serve both as a reminder of the greatness of the United States of America and as a call to action to stand together as the beacon of freedom our world needs now more than ever! These are among the many reasons why I have chosen to run for U.S.Congress - to be in service to Connecticut’s Fourth District and for a brighter future.In the important words of Former Navy SEAL, Senior Chief James Hatch, “if we truly wish to honor our Veterans, we must live life full and take care of one another and our great country.” I hope I have earned your trust and support. God Bless America and our Veterans! | | Hi Peter, Early voting ended in NC yesterday and it’s been pretty incredible to see what’s happening on the ground here – voting lines around the block even in heavy rains, college students driving home to vote in person, people bringing their kids so they can be part of the process too. Coming out of early voting, NC-11 leads the state in turnout and number of doors knocked as well. We know that the best way to drive turnout is by getting out there to knock doors and have in person conversations with folks. And we’re so grateful to the incredible team of volunteers who are showing up to knock doors with us every day of the week. I spent the afternoon knocking doors with my friend Martin Moore, who is running for County Commission. We talked with people who are still deciding whether to vote or not – “will it even matter?” one man asked. I get why people ask this question, in a time when it can feel like so much is broken about our politics. And it’s also why it matters so much to show up and meet people where they are, to ask what matters to them, to share a vision of how we can move forward together. This evening, we wrapped up a call with candidates and Democratic Party leaders across Western NC and our team here in NC-11 is dialed in and ready to hit the gas. And we need your help to make sure we can push as hard as possible to turn out every single vote we need. Knocking doors, making calls, sending texts, working the polls, digging deep to donate again – it’s going to take all of us being all in. **[As of right now, we’re falling $16,817 short of our Get Out the Vote Fund goal. Years of playing football taught me that we can’t slow down in the fourth quarter. I need you on the team and in the game. |

Fellow American,

_From my years playing football for the Georgia Bulldogs and multiple teams in the NFL, I know how critical the final minutes of the 4th Quarter can be._

It's no different in this political campaign. Everything is on the line as control of the U.S. Senate runs through Georgia, so the stakes and pressure are tremendous. We're exhausted, but we've got to keep giving 110% until the last polling location closes on Tuesday.

[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=d87b30aacc48480f8c5510589abe2146&_e=4nZS59lqc6N3_6zbhVlRN8ciBjHdWdIM5JOPRUQAbA8LCbDGFGIHchB8fNV1k_EDU3ymqopjuQy_67K_E7I48Tpzn3Yu7z4710dMMQj4oT-ddwNFdS21WKoezR7uoDpY77Wjewl2lOEr_YJpwWjTiCkIAqWHCukQB2265Lh6ZTZmCUDev9BNAfsj2iqnxzUA9bMFM6GPC4_NB1TVIZEFct3QU8CGlrMGiOFPjX1IOVFSFEk11_BGiBoaXdljJiZEMsnbyMV3QHwNYcH__lu9kA1HZzv4UrY9BiLpxoB3RGs_aOvBviL-j8h4aVwuEbtDxTkhXmDs-l6XFNZ7RuE_c7P2RmY2uxyuOi98R-Vpmt2v_Yqd5udq3zDcUmnA8uAyMTo4a5pLFBl4BA1FITJxHw%3D%3D)
Fellow American, the Left underestimated us. They thought they would beat me in a landslide because I had never run for office before. _**But they were wrong.**_

Derek,

Donald Trump went on another rant against me at his final Pennsylvania
rally — one of his last warmup acts before reportedly announcing his
presidential campaign next week.

“Shifty Adam Schiff and the whole group, they’re really sleaze...Adam Schiff made
up my phone call. He said Trump said all of this horrible stuff, and he imitated
me...Schiff, Shifty Schiff, went before Congress and spewed out a speech...and it
was a totally phony speech.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=nov2022_abs_em.lEaqBw&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20221106_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1004&akid=1289%2E5257348%2E_kMGzU ]Donald Trump wearing MAGA hat at Pennsylvania rally

He was talking about the phone call in which he attempted to extort
Ukraine’s President, Volodymyr Zelensky, by withholding American military
aid in their fight against the Russians. In exchange, Trump wanted
Zelensky to smear Joe Biden and help Trump in his losing re-election
campaign.

And just today at another rally in Florida, the twice-impeached former guy
attacked me again, calling me “a total fraud” and a “crooked person.”

“Yet after all their lies and corruption, these same people, like Shifty Adam
Schiff ... people say that is not a nice name, Shifty Adam Schiff. He’s not a
dummy, but a total fraud. This represents watermelon head, so I said watermelon
head. People said that is not a nice thing. I said this guy tried to destroy a
lot of very good people. He’s a bad guy, a crooked person.”

Here's the bottom line: We can’t let the Republican Party take back
Congress and give Donald Trump a bigger platform to spread his lies,

| | | | Election Day is the day after tomorrow, and #TeamLizzie is covering a lot of ground to make sure Texans are voting. We need your help to get across the finish line!

As you know by now, we’ve sent mail and personalized postcards, and we’ve put ads on TV, and on line. We’ve sent thousands of texts. And we are out knocking doors now.

That is because every voter contact we make between now and Election Day makes a difference in the final outcome on Tuesday. Every single one.

**So today, I’m asking members of #TeamLizzie to text three of your friends and family about voting. We even have you covered on what to say to them — just copy and paste the language below directly into your text! **

Lizzie
